verification_method: Each keyless board was confirmed by fetching its public API (boards-api.greenhouse.io/v1/boards/<token>/jobs, api.lever.co/v0/postings/<site>, api.ashbyhq.com/posting-api/job-board/<org>) and checking the board's own company name and job locations. Workday and 'other' entries were confirmed by fetching the careers page and finding the ATS host in its links. 'unknown' means the careers page was reachable but exposed no recognizable ATS link at fetch time.
